cards.front: Recall a key point about Pronouns and Negation
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for pronouns and negation. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: Direct object pronouns (lo, la, los, las) replace nouns. Indirect object pronouns (le, les) go before the verb. Double object pronouns follow a specific order (se lo, se la). Negation uses no before the verb; double negatives are required (no... nada, no... nunca).
because of/through/for (e.g. No salí por la lluvia)
for/in order to/destination (e.g. Estudio para aprobar el examen)
without (e.g. Un café sin azúcar, por favor)
on/about (e.g. Una película sobre Frida Kahlo)
moreover/furthermore (e.g. Además, la comida es genial)
however (e.g. Es caro; sin embargo, vale la pena)

cards.front: What does por lo tanto mean?
cards.back: therefore (e.g. No estudió; por lo tanto, suspendió)
although (e.g. Aunque llueva, iré al parque)
Writing task: Write about subject pronouns, object pronouns, reflexive pronouns, double object pronouns, negation words.
